# surface.offset_surface: per-case four-term attribution (2026-11-04)

Updates: plan/findings/surface.offset_surface--default-third-derivatives-diagnostic-attribution.md

At source commit `8ec4825280f7b2f9a41fc4183d609f8a080146e9`, the native diagnostic reported 3,182 cases, 2,663 pass and 519 fail; the 518 remaining cases below contain 2,206 mismatches. The legacy counterfactual reverts all four terms as a bundle: full outputs, statuses and lengths agree with C++ at the unchanged 1e-9 relative comparator for all 518. This is not a single-term isolation or proof of C++ internals. The Rust runs used their own inputs, not C++ outputs. Pinned C++ source/header blobs match `3fd5b9548d19aa8c12c29bc9637a96d42a06f8a5`; native library hashes match historical build receipts, not a reproducible-build proof. No current integrated-head native pass is claimed. Original runner inputs are reconstructed at the source commit using `crates/difftest/src/units/surface_offset_surface.rs` and the fixture or generator seed indicated per case, with the canonical input hash as a check.

The already confirmed `third_derivative_outputs` case remains under its existing marker and is excluded below. After these records were published, the maintainer-authorized 282 conditional-local cases are listed against the confirmed WR-160/161 addenda. Together there are 283 case-specific markers. The other 236 cases remain ordinary running failures: 103 relative-jet cases, 9 pole cases, 8 fallback cases and 116 alias cases awaiting #2717 (including missing `cvv`/`nvv` prerequisites). The alias cases are not listed against WR-160/161. No tolerance changes or post-marker full native sweep is claimed.
